authorities.tool_claim_compatibility_owner: SQLite RunStore until M3-T06 PostgreSQL cutover
authorities.redis: discardable cache, single-flight and rate-limit coordination only

tool_expiry_contract.claimed_before_invoke: expired claim may be reclaimed with a new token
tool_expiry_contract.read_only_invoking: expired invocation may be recomputed with a new token
tool_expiry_contract.write_invoking: expired invocation enters reconciling and cannot be re-invoked
tool_expiry_contract.not_committed_receipt: same operation may be claimed again

generation_contract.activation: expected pointer version CAS in one PostgreSQL transaction

invariants: one execution pointer transition per invocation version
late lease owners cannot acknowledge, renew or release a newer claim epoch
ambiguous write effects are never blindly retried
one active retrieval generation per corpus and backend
Redis loss does not change retrieval result semantics or create authority
